title: Library Doctor
sub: A private health check for your backup
priv: 100% private — your file never leaves this device.
safe: Your original file is never changed — fixes go into a new copy.
err_read: Could not read this backup — it may be corrupted or the wrong type of file.
err_db: This backup is missing its notes database (userData.db).
done_ready: Your cleaned backup is ready to download.
will_fix: These will be fixed automatically in your merged file.
rv_d: Nothing is deleted until you tap Clean. Uncheck anything you'd like to keep.
rv_none: Select at least one item to clean.
